title: Hyperspace intake
description: Everything the intake collects before the hit (BUILD.md sections 6.1 and 8). Doses are relative steps only, never real amounts.

room.description: Room source (section 8.1). Paths are relative to the session folder.

source.description: photo, phone panorama (2:1 equirectangular) or the built-in default room.

image.description: Stored room image, e.g. assets/room.jpg; null or absent for the default room.

depth.description: Depth map, e.g. assets/room_depth.png; null or absent when not computed yet.

answers.description: Intake answers (section 8.2) that become hidden variables.

absorption.description: Three absorption-style items, 0-10 each; the planner uses their mean.

surrender.description: Preoccupied (0) to ready to let go (10).

expectations.description: Motifs seen before (multi-select); each multiplies the matching entity weight by 1.5. Empty for none.

hold_fraction.description: min(1, hold_seconds / 4) of the hit (section 8.4); 1 before the hit has happened.

difficult_passages.description: true: difficult passages may be sampled; false: gentle mode.

eyes.description: Eyes mode: auto fades to eyes-closed at visual intensity 3.
